stories.title: James Morrison and Jack Savoretti announced as first Live at Llangollen Pavilion 2027 headliners
stories.summary: Chart topping British-Italian singer-songwriter Jack Savoretti and You Give Me Something hitmaker James Morrison have been announced as the first headliners for Live at Llangollen Pavilion 2027. The singer-songwriters will hit the road in June and July for a double-headlining tour, including a date in Llangollen on Friday June 25. Jack Savoretti and James Morrison

stories.title: World Suicide Prevention Day falls on September 10, with Mind Cymru urging people to talk openly
stories.summary: World Suicide Prevention Day falls on September 10. This year’s theme is changing the narrative on suicide, with the aim of encouraging people to talk about suicide and suicidal behaviour more openly. Mind Cymru says talking about mental health can still feel scary or shameful for many people, and wants to help reduce that stigma.

stories.title: Police praise police dog Arlo after he was bitten on duty
stories.summary: Police dog Arlo was bitten while helping Wrexham officers detain a suspect over the weekend. North Wales Police said the suspect had been evading officers for much of the afternoon before Arlo helped bring the arrest to an end. The force said Arlo was able to carry on despite being bitten.
